Based on the provided material, here is the answer to your question regarding CIP-007-6 R5 Part 5.2.

### What Part 5.2 Requires

Part 5.2 requires the Responsible Entity to **identify and inventory all known enabled default or other generic account types**. This inventory can be organized by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s).

The specific regulatory text states:
> "Identify and inventory all known enabled default or other generic account types, either by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s)." [csection-ec458b69bb605a5c345a]

Additionally, the requirement text in Section 5.2 specifies that where possible, these accounts should be removed, renamed, or disabled prior to production use. If this is not possible, passwords must be changed from the default, and any remaining enabled default or generic accounts must be documented [csection-babf06d3f1ed425a7b4a].

### Which Document Shows Compliance

The operator's document that demonstrates this requirement is met is the **CIP Cyber Security Policy**, specifically section **3.4.5 System Access Controls Process (R5)**.

This document explicitly states that "LSPG shall document and implement a system access control process to: ... **Identify and inventory all known enabled default or other generic account types, either by system, by groups of systems, by location, or by system type(s) (Part 5.2)**" [isection-fbc9ce9e2439c4f4af90].
